distributions.name: σ (NC quasi-elastic on 16O)
distributions.provenance: T2K:2014vog — first measurement of the neutrino-oxygen NCQE cross section at Super-Kamiokande via nuclear deexcitation gamma-rays; NCQE (nucleon knockout) on ¹⁶O in the Super-K water target, per oxygen nucleus, T2K off-axis narrow-band beam (~93% numu), single flux-averaged value at median E_nu 630 MeV, σ=1.55 ×10^-38 cm^2; transcribed from the paper · asymmetric 68% CI (1.20, 2.26) ×10^-38 cm^2 (90% CI (0.96, 2.78)); the stored error is the symmetric half-width 0.53 ×10^-38 cm^2
distributions.notes: Asymmetric 68% CI (1.20, 2.26) ×10^-38 cm^2 (90% CI (0.96, 2.78)); the stored error is the symmetric half-width 0.53 ×10^-38 cm^2.
